feedback: Your essay addresses the topic of cellphones in the classroom, but it needs more focus on structure and flow. Currently, your ideas are presented as a list of short, simple sentences. To improve, try to group related points into coherent paragraphs and use linking words (such as 'furthermore,' 'however,' or 'consequently') to connect your thoughts. This will help your argument move logically from one point to the next. Additionally, try to expand on your examples; instead of just stating that a phone can help with research, explain exactly how that improves the learning experience. Focusing on these areas will help you build a more convincing and professional argument.
